sources.title: GitHub - MoonshotAI/Kimi-K2.5: Open Visual Agentic Intelligence
sources.snippet: Kimi K2.5 is an open-source, native multimodal agentic model built through continual pretraining on approximately 15 trillion mixed visual and text tokens atop Kimi-K2-Base. It seamlessly integrates vision and language understanding with advanced agentic capabilities, instant and thinking modes, as well as conversational and agentic paradigms.
